title: Example 6:Forecasts from the period of the previous year and changes to period
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:42 AM
01(05) = periodic meter reading for allocation month May, and so on

The expected meter reading for 01(05) is determined based on the demand with the same allocation month from the period of the
previous year 1(05) = 120 kW

The expected meter reading result is 120 kW .
